by: converted (convert1d) from fact_check__1.json and the research's 3 searches

checks.claim: Hoover Dam is 660 feet thick at its base and only 45 feet thick at its top.
checks.why: USGS, NPS and ASCE all give 660 feet at the base and 45 feet at the top.

checks.claim: Every 10 metres of water adds about one atmosphere of pressure, so 100 metres down the water pushes about 10 times harder than the air.
checks.why: WHOI gives one atmosphere per 10 m; at 100 m about 10 atm from the water, 11 in total.

sources.title: Why is pressure different in the ocean? (WHOI)

checks.claim: Overtopping, water flowing over the top, caused about 34 percent of dam failures.
checks.why: Bureau of Reclamation and Washington Ecology cite Costa (1985): 34 percent.

sources.title: D-3 Flood Overtopping Failure of Dams and Levees (USBR)
